parsed.name: 数据混合扩展
parsed.description: 这是一个用于实验测控流程的数据处理扩展，而非可明确识别的独立物理仪器。它用于汇集多个探测器的数据，按选定模型进行处理，生成计算结果或虚拟探测器信号，并用于实时快照、结果可视化和实验数据融合。
parsed.description_en: This appears to be a data-processing extension rather than a clearly identifiable standalone physical instrument. It is used in laboratory measurement workflows to combine data from multiple detectors, process them with a selected model, generate computed or virtual detector signals, and support real-time snapshots, visualization, and data fusion.
